description: Studds Accessories Limited engages in the designing, manufacturing, marketing, and sale of helmets and riding accessories in India and internationally. The company offers full face, flip up face, open face, and off road helmet; arm sleeves, balaclava, cable lock, riding jackets, and motorcycle side luggage; and protective googles. It sells its products under the STUDDS and SMK brands. It serves daily commuter and rider. The company also exports its products to Europe, Asia, the Americas, Africa, and internationally. Studds Accessories Limited was founded in 1972 and is based in Faridabad, India.
